column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 15 (M23015): Graurizard merobek kubah; Asteria & Dandelion menembak.
# Tetap Inggris: Graurizard, Boojum, Collapse Pieces, Shell of Amni, Vindicator's Mark,
# Gungnir, Winged Hussars, Zucchero, Asteria, Dandelion, Vasily, Wulfgar, Mokosh,
# Mangi Security, The Elmo, Squad 404, Monsoon, Oathguards, Doll, Neural cloud.
# "chuunibyou" dipertahankan — istilah yang sudah akrab bagi gamer Indonesia.
# Catatan: satu baris di file Inggris masih berbahasa Mandarin (bunyi alarm).
Commander, the enemy's offensive has slowed down! As expected, your Dolls' hard work has achieved a decisive result.
column2: Komandan, serangan musuh melambat! Seperti dugaan, kerja keras para Doll Anda membuahkan hasil yang menentukan.

column1: Everyone's sacrifice... was not in vain.
column2: Pengorbanan semua orang... tidak sia-sia.

column1: (After the Doll squad's raid on the bridge, the enemy's offensive showed obvious chaos.)
column2: (Setelah penyerbuan regu Doll ke anjungan, serangan musuh jelas menjadi kacau.)

column1: (On the battlefield, although the enemy forces engaging the Dolls were still attacking, many areas frequently experienced coordination errors with their surroundings due to the loss of command.)
column2: (Di medan tempur, meski pasukan musuh yang berhadapan dengan para Doll masih menyerang, banyak area sering salah koordinasi dengan sekitarnya karena kehilangan komando.)

column1: (And taking advantage of the enemy's brief confusion, the Elmo forcefully charged into the enemy's hinterland, utilizing its massive mass and powerful acceleration kinetic energy to launch an 'overwhelming' strike against the enemy's artillery formations and logistical supplies.)
column2: (Dan memanfaatkan kebingungan sesaat musuh, Elmo menerjang paksa ke jantung wilayah musuh, memakai massa raksasa dan energi kinetik akselerasinya yang dahsyat untuk melancarkan gempuran 'menggilas' terhadap formasi artileri dan pasokan logistik musuh.)

column1: (In the end, The Elmo, carrying out my tactical intentions, successfully cut into Mangi Security's rear, seized a large amount of supplies, and achieved battle results worth boasting about.)
column2: (Pada akhirnya, Elmo yang menjalankan maksud taktisku berhasil menerobos barisan belakang Mangi Security, merampas banyak perbekalan, dan meraih hasil tempur yang pantas dibanggakan.)

column1: All squads, seize the opportunity! Take advantage of the enemy's chaotic command system to break through the encirclement!
column2: Seluruh regu, manfaatkan kesempatan ini! Gunakan kacaunya sistem komando musuh untuk menembus kepungan!

column1: Third-generation Doll squad, charge into the enemy's flank! Squad 404, Monsoon, coordinate at 11 o'clock to eliminate the remaining forces!
column2: Regu Doll generasi ketiga, terjang sayap musuh! Squad 404, Monsoon, berkoordinasi di arah jam 11 untuk melenyapkan sisa pasukannya!

column1: (Soon, the squads counterattacking in the central ground war zone merged into a sharp knife, slicing through the densely woven battle formation and piercing towards the enemy's heart.)
column2: (Tak lama, regu-regu yang balik menyerang di zona perang darat tengah menyatu bagai pisau tajam, mengiris formasi tempur yang teranyam rapat dan menusuk ke jantung musuh.)

column1: (However—)
column2: (Namun—)

column1: （嘀嘀嘀嘀嘀嘀嘀——）
column2: （Bip bip bip bip bip bip bip——）

column1: (The excitement in the command center didn't last long before a sharp alarm suddenly blared. The constantly flashing glaring red light even rose to the peak of brightness in an instant, enveloping the entire command center in an ominous blood color—)
column2: (Kegembiraan di pusat komando tak berlangsung lama sebelum sirene melengking mendadak meraung. Lampu merah menyilaukan yang terus berkedip bahkan melonjak ke terang maksimal seketika, menyelimuti seluruh pusat komando dengan warna darah yang mengerikan—)

column1: Airstrike, it's an airstrike alarm! The alert level is—highest alert?!
column2: Serangan udara, ini sirene serangan udara! Tingkat siaganya—siaga tertinggi?!

column1: (*BOOM—*)
column2: (*BUUM—*)

column1: (Rumble—)
column2: (Gemuruh—)

column1: (Synchronized with the red light and alarms came a deafening roar that echoed through the dome, and a tremor that spread across the earth.)
column2: (Serempak dengan lampu merah dan sirene, datang raungan memekakkan yang menggema di seluruh kubah, dan getaran yang menjalar ke seantero bumi.)

column1: Woah...!
column2: Waduh...!

column1: (The young man in front of the console let out a scream at the screen—)
column2: (Pemuda di depan konsol itu memekik ke arah layar—)

column1: W-What is that—
column2: A-Apa itu—

column1: (On the screen, there is only a roaming dark shadow.)
column2: (Di layar, hanya ada bayangan gelap yang berkeliaran.)

column1: (That shadow is so massive, majestic, and ferocious. Like an abyssal darkness circling above the battlefield, several streams of golden-red 'flames' pour out from its spine, along with cyan energy spewed from its giant maw, crashing ruthlessly toward the city's force field shield and Mokosh's close-in weapon systems.)
column2: (Bayangan itu begitu raksasa, megah, dan buas. Bagai kegelapan jurang yang berputar di atas medan tempur, beberapa aliran 'api' merah keemasan mengucur dari tulang punggungnya, disertai energi biru kehijauan yang disemburkan dari rahang raksasanya, menghantam tanpa ampun perisai medan gaya kota dan sistem senjata jarak dekat Mokosh.)

column1: (That Boojum dragon actually came to Mokosh too. No, compared to the last time we met, it has grown even larger, like an agile aerial battleship.)
column2: (Naga Boojum itu ternyata datang juga ke Mokosh. Bukan, dibanding terakhir kali kami bertemu, dia bahkan tumbuh makin besar, bagai kapal perang udara yang lincah.)

column1: (At this moment, the dragon is diving rapidly towards the ground. From its spread wings, several powerful 'shells' made of Collapse Pieces are continuously firing at the ground.)
column2: (Saat ini naga itu menukik cepat ke arah tanah. Dari sayapnya yang terbentang, beberapa 'peluru' dahsyat dari Collapse Pieces terus ditembakkan ke bawah.)

column1: Warning, system defense energy has reached its limit! The backup energy system is also—
column2: Peringatan, energi pertahanan sistem sudah mencapai batas! Sistem energi cadangan juga—

column1: (This dense attack has exceeded the limits of Mokosh's air defense system—)
column2: (Serangan serapat ini sudah melampaui batas kemampuan sistem pertahanan udara Mokosh—)

column1: (BOOM—!!!)
column2: (BUUM—!!!)

column1: (A white light seemed to flash briefly before my eyes. Everything seemed to stand still for a moment, only the roar of energies clashing with each other echoed through the screen into the command room.)
column2: (Cahaya putih seolah berkelebat sekejap di depan mataku. Segalanya seakan membeku sesaat, hanya deru energi yang saling beradu bergema lewat layar ke dalam ruang komando.)

column1: (The next moment, golden sparks tore through the sky.)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, percikan keemasan merobek langit.)

column1: (Mokosh's air defense system was completely destroyed under the giant dragon's strikes.)
column2: (Sistem pertahanan udara Mokosh hancur total di bawah gempuran naga raksasa itu.)

column1: All ground squads attention, quickly find nearby cover and dodge the airstrike!
column2: Seluruh regu darat perhatian, cepat cari perlindungan terdekat dan hindari serangan udara!

column1: (With the failure of the air defense system, the ground combat troops quickly fell into a predicament. The Oathguards' offensive completely paused, and the Doll squads were trying to counterattack relying on cover.)
column2: (Dengan lumpuhnya sistem pertahanan udara, pasukan tempur darat cepat terjepit. Serangan Oathguards terhenti sepenuhnya, dan regu-regu Doll berusaha balas menyerang dengan bertumpu pada perlindungan.)

column1: (However, in front of the massive giant dragon, all resistance was futile.)
column2: (Namun di hadapan naga raksasa itu, semua perlawanan sia-sia.)

column1: (Heavenly fire was still bombarding the ground. The giant dragon spat energy, swiftly flew over the crowd, and its huge wings swept across the battlefield, blowing away all tiny obstacles.)
column2: (Api dari langit masih menggempur bumi. Naga raksasa itu menyemburkan energi, melesat di atas kerumunan, dan sayap raksasanya menyapu medan tempur, menerbangkan semua penghalang kecil.)

column1: (Under the giant dragon's continuous strikes, the tremors coming from the dome became increasingly violent. And once the dome was destroyed, the enemy troops would pour in through the destroyed entrance, which would be extremely disadvantageous to Mokosh.)
column2: (Di bawah gempuran naga raksasa yang bertubi-tubi, getaran dari kubah makin hebat. Dan begitu kubahnya hancur, pasukan musuh akan membanjir masuk lewat celah itu, dan itu sangat merugikan Mokosh.)

column1: Commander, the dome is about to give way! I'll go arrange the evacuation of the remaining personnel on the ground, you guys evacuate as soon as possible too!
column2: Komandan, kubahnya hampir jebol! Saya akan mengatur evakuasi sisa personel di permukaan, kalian juga segera menyingkir!

column1: Yes, please be careful! All personnel in the command center, prepare to evacuate immediately and activate the underground command post!
column2: Ya, hati-hati! Seluruh personel pusat komando, bersiap menyingkir sekarang dan aktifkan pos komando bawah tanah!

column1: Command center calling Wulfgar! Immediately activate the Shell of Amni to block falling objects and evacuate residents!
column2: Pusat komando memanggil Wulfgar! Segera aktifkan Shell of Amni untuk menahan benda jatuh dan evakuasi warga!

column1: (Vasily grabbed the communicator and prepared to leave, and the other personnel in the command room also quickly began to move.)
column2: (Vasily menyambar komunikator dan bersiap pergi, dan personel lain di ruang komando pun cepat bergerak.)

column1: (But at this very moment, a loud noise came from the broadcast screen and the zenith simultaneously. The earth trembled again, and amidst this continuously intensifying tremor, a crack appeared in the "sky".)
column2: (Tapi tepat saat itu, bunyi keras datang serentak dari layar siaran dan dari langit-langit. Bumi kembali berguncang, dan di tengah getaran yang terus menguat itu, muncul retakan di "langit".)

column1: (Then, a second, a third...)
column2: (Lalu yang kedua, yang ketiga...)

column1: (Wham!)
column2: (Brak!)

column1: (Bang bang!!)
column2: (Brak brak!!)

column1: (Like a seed breaking through the sprouting soil, or a newborn chick pecking through its eggshell, a sharp giant claw suddenly broke through the dome. Then, a second and third giant claw tore at the "sky", and the massive dragon body squeezed into the crack, continuing to impact the obstacles in front of it with "cannonballs" and energy.)
column2: (Bagai benih yang menembus tanah saat bertunas, atau anak ayam yang mematuk keluar dari cangkangnya, sebuah cakar raksasa yang tajam tiba-tiba menembus kubah. Lalu cakar raksasa kedua dan ketiga mencabik "langit", dan tubuh naga yang masif menyusup masuk ke celah itu, terus menghantam penghalang di depannya dengan "peluru meriam" dan energi.)

column1: (In just a few short seconds.)
column2: (Hanya dalam beberapa detik singkat.)

column1: (Mokosh's towering steel dome shattered with a loud crash amidst the giant dragon's tearing—)
column2: (Kubah baja Mokosh yang menjulang itu pecah berkeping dengan gemuruh dahsyat di bawah cabikan naga raksasa—)

column1: —Oh no!
column2: —Gawat!

column1: Everyone, find a place to take cover immediately!
column2: Semuanya, segera cari tempat berlindung!

column1: (Fragments of steel and concrete rained down from the sky, smashing into buildings and streets on the ground, and the command center building was once again subjected to impact.)
column2: (Serpihan baja dan beton berhamburan dari langit, menghantam bangunan dan jalanan di bawah, dan gedung pusat komando kembali terkena hantaman.)

column1: (The intruding dragon recklessly smashed between the buildings, and countless drones swarmed in through the 'hole' in the dome right behind the dragon. Bullets rained down, burning on the streets alongside the artillery shells poured by the dragon, turning Mokosh into a city of purgatory.)
column2: (Naga yang menyusup itu menghantam sembarangan di antara bangunan, dan drone tak terhitung menyerbu masuk lewat 'lubang' di kubah tepat di belakangnya. Peluru menghujan, membakar jalanan bersama peluru artileri yang dimuntahkan sang naga, mengubah Mokosh jadi kota neraka.)

column1: These guys...
column2: Orang-orang ini...

column1: These guys—!!
column2: Orang-orang ini—!!

column1: (Vasily, who hadn't gone far, pounded the wall fiercely. He gritted his teeth, angry tears welling in his eyes.)
column2: (Vasily yang belum jauh melangkah meninju dinding sekuat tenaga. Dia mengertakkan gigi, air mata amarah menggenang di matanya.)

column1: (I couldn't comfort him.)
column2: (Aku tidak bisa menghiburnya.)

column1: (No words could comfort him, nor the people beside me who grew up alongside Mokosh.)
column2: (Tidak ada kata yang bisa menghiburnya, tidak pula orang-orang di sekitarku yang tumbuh besar bersama Mokosh.)

column1: (Right now, they were all gathered by the screens, silently watching the rain of bullets and flames outside, quietly listening to the roar of artillery and cries coming from the streets. They gritted their teeth, clenched their fists, they were angry, they were crying.)
column2: (Saat ini mereka semua berkumpul di depan layar, membisu menatap hujan peluru dan kobaran api di luar, diam-diam mendengarkan deru artileri dan jeritan dari jalanan. Mereka mengertakkan gigi, mengepalkan tinju, mereka marah, mereka menangis.)

column1: (I stared at them blankly, wanting to say something, but unable to organize effective words anymore.)
column2: (Kutatap mereka dengan hampa, ingin mengatakan sesuatu, tapi tak lagi sanggup merangkai kata yang berarti.)

column1: (In the days past, I had never regretted helping Mokosh, nor had I ever wavered in my choice to resist.)
column2: (Selama ini aku tidak pernah menyesal membantu Mokosh, tidak pula pernah goyah dengan pilihanku untuk melawan.)

column1: (But at this very moment, I suddenly hesitated.)
column2: (Tapi tepat saat ini, aku mendadak ragu.)

column1: (——If this campaign had never existed to begin with, would this situation still have occurred?)
column2: (——Kalau kampanye ini sejak awal tidak pernah ada, apakah keadaan ini tetap akan terjadi?)

column1: (No... I shouldn't be making such meaningless assumptions right now.)
column2: (Tidak... aku tidak seharusnya membuat andaian tak berarti seperti itu sekarang.)

column1: (The real mistake right now is that I neglected to defend against aerial firepower. So, what is the solution? How do we shoot down that dragon?)
column2: (Kesalahan yang sebenarnya sekarang adalah aku lalai mengantisipasi daya tembak dari udara. Jadi, apa solusinya? Bagaimana cara menjatuhkan naga itu?)

column1: (Chaotic thoughts are still tumbling when an abnormal ringing comes through the headset. I stare at the screen unconsciously, and in a corner of my vision, several blasts of artillery fire are flying toward a familiar building—)
column2: (Pikiran yang kacau masih bergolak saat dengung yang tak wajar terdengar lewat headset. Tanpa sadar kutatap layar, dan di sudut pandanganku, beberapa semburan tembakan artileri melesat ke arah sebuah bangunan yang kukenal—)

column1: Look out—!
column2: Awas—!

column1: (I pushed Vasily away.)
column2: (Kudorong Vasily menjauh.)

column1: (Bang!)
column2: (Blam!)

column1: (A huge shockwave came from the wall. The thick tempered glass shattered under the artillery fire.)
column2: (Gelombang kejut besar datang dari arah dinding. Kaca tempered yang tebal itu pecah berkeping di bawah tembakan artileri.)

column1: (I fell to the ground. For an instant, the world was left with only endless darkness and buzzing sounds.)
column2: (Aku terjatuh ke lantai. Sesaat, dunia hanya menyisakan kegelapan tanpa ujung dan dengung yang mendengung.)

column1: (In the dilapidated streets and alleys of Mokosh, the flames of war were spreading everywhere.)
column2: (Di jalan dan gang Mokosh yang porak-poranda, kobaran perang menjalar ke mana-mana.)

column1: (That giant dragon named "Graurizard" was circling among the gloomy clouds, letting out deafening roars.)
column2: (Naga raksasa bernama "Graurizard" itu berputar di antara awan kelabu, mengaum memekakkan telinga.)

column1: (After a long trek, two vigorous figures leaped out from the shadows like ghosts, lightly climbing onto the roof of a nearby ruin with a relatively open view.)
column2: (Setelah perjalanan panjang, dua sosok tangkas melompat keluar dari bayangan bagai hantu, ringan memanjat ke atap reruntuhan terdekat yang pandangannya cukup terbuka.)

column1: Finally... showed up.
column2: Akhirnya... muncul juga.

column1: After tracking for so long, it's time to end this.
column2: Setelah sekian lama melacak, saatnya mengakhiri ini.

column1: Although this power is not enough to completely kill you, at least...
column2: Meski kekuatan ini belum cukup untuk benar-benar membunuhmu, setidaknya...

column1: I say, can you stop talking to yourself to the air like a bitter and deeply resentful protagonist in a crime drama?
column2: Aku bilang, bisa tidak kau berhenti bicara sendiri ke udara seperti tokoh utama drama kriminal yang pahit dan penuh dendam?

column1: (A lazy voice, out of place with the current tense atmosphere, interrupted Asteria's soliloquy.)
column2: (Suara malas yang sama sekali tak cocok dengan suasana tegang saat itu memotong monolog Asteria.)

column1: So many years have passed, and you still haven't grown out of that "Crime and Punishment" chuunibyou?
column2: Sudah bertahun-tahun berlalu, dan kau masih belum lepas dari chuunibyou "Crime and Punishment" itu?

column1: (Seeing the Doll in front of her disdaining to pay attention to her, just staring fixedly at the giant dragon, Dandelion cleared her throat and began to imitate with a vivid tone.)
column2: (Melihat Doll di depannya enggan menanggapinya dan hanya menatap lekat naga raksasa itu, Dandelion berdeham lalu mulai menirukan dengan nada yang hidup.)

column1: Only this feeling makes me feel at ease~
column2: Hanya perasaan ini yang membuatku tenang~

column1: (Asteria's movements suddenly stiffened.)
column2: (Gerakan Asteria mendadak kaku.)

column1: Enough! Shut up! If you hadn't insisted on me picking you up, we wouldn't be this late!
column2: Cukup! Diam! Kalau kau tidak memaksaku menjemputmu, kita tidak akan seterlambat ini!

column1: Oh my... after all, it's been a long time since I went out in person. I don't want to roll around in the mud and get my beautiful new clothes dirty.
column2: Aduh... lagi pula sudah lama aku tidak turun sendiri. Aku tidak mau berguling di lumpur dan mengotori baju baruku yang cantik.

column1: I'm not like you pink... hmm, should I call you "Pink Sword and Shield Warrior" now?
column2: Aku tidak seperti kau yang merah muda... hmm, sekarang aku harus memanggilmu "Pink Sword and Shield Warrior"?

column1: Anyway, I'm different from you, I'm very delicate.
column2: Lagi pula, aku beda denganmu, aku ini rapuh.

column1: ...You guy—!
column2: ...Dasar kau—!

column1: Oh my, you're not allowed to hit me, okay?
column2: Aduh, kamu tidak boleh memukulku, ya?

column1: If I remember correctly, the 'immunity' we agreed upon back then should still have quite a few uses left, right?
column2: Kalau ingatanku benar, 'kekebalan' yang kita sepakati dulu masih tersisa cukup banyak jatahnya, kan?

column1: ...Hmph, to think you still remember that boring stuff.
column2: ...Hmph, tak kusangka kamu masih ingat hal membosankan itu.

column1: (Dandelion shrugged with a wicked smile. Asteria ignored her teasing and turned her gaze back to the giant dragon soaring in the sky.)
column2: (Dandelion mengangkat bahu dengan senyum nakal. Asteria mengabaikan godaannya dan mengembalikan pandangannya ke naga raksasa yang melayang di langit.)

column1: (Asteria had been tracking this Boojum named "Graurizard" for a long time. She had wanted to wait for the perfect moment for a one-hit kill, but the current battle was urgent, and she couldn't wait any longer.)
column2: (Asteria sudah lama melacak Boojum bernama "Graurizard" itu. Dia ingin menunggu momen sempurna untuk sekali habisi, tapi pertempuran saat ini mendesak, dan dia tak bisa menunggu lagi.)

column1: (This attack will at least help the Commander temporarily alleviate the current predicament.)
column2: (Serangan ini setidaknya akan membantu Komandan meredakan kesulitan saat ini untuk sementara.)

column1: (Asteria unfastened the heavy weapon case from her back and slammed it heavily onto the rubble on the roof.)
column2: (Asteria melepas koper senjata berat dari punggungnya dan membantingnya keras ke atas puing di atap.)

column1: (She drew out an exaggeratedly large weapon from it.)
column2: (Dari dalamnya dia menarik keluar senjata berukuran berlebihan.)

column1: (She had secretly sworn that she would absolutely not easily use this power, lest that person look down on her... but now, she understood that right now was the time when she had to use this power—)
column2: (Dia diam-diam bersumpah tidak akan sembarangan memakai kekuatan ini, agar orang itu tidak meremehkannya... tapi sekarang dia paham, inilah saatnya kekuatan ini harus dipakai—)

column1: (Asteria finally understood her a little.)
column2: (Asteria akhirnya sedikit memahaminya.)

column1: (Asteria set up the "Vindicator's Mark", constantly adjusting for the best shooting angle, but due to still having some unfamiliarity with this weapon, she found it a bit difficult to perfectly control it for a while.)
column2: (Asteria memasang "Vindicator's Mark", terus menyetel sudut tembak terbaik, tapi karena masih agak asing dengan senjata ini, dia sempat kesulitan mengendalikannya dengan sempurna.)

column1: (Dandelion watched leisurely from the side.)
column2: (Dandelion menonton santai dari samping.)

column1: To the left, to the left... no, too far, too far... a little more to the right, oh my, too slow, too slow! It flew up there again!
column2: Ke kiri, ke kiri... bukan, kejauhan, kejauhan... sedikit ke kanan, aduh, lambat, lambat sekali! Dia terbang ke atas sana lagi!

column1: Don't just stand there watching the show! Get over here and support me properly!
column2: Jangan cuma berdiri nonton! Ke sini dan dukung aku dengan benar!

column1: Y-Yes... Does Miss Asteria mind physical contact?
column2: I-Iya... Apa Nona Asteria keberatan dengan sentuhan fisik?

column1: HURRY! UP!!!
column2: CE! PAT!!!

column1: (Dandelion steps forward with a soft chuckle, gently resting her hands on Asteria's shoulders.)
column2: (Dandelion melangkah maju sambil terkekeh pelan, meletakkan tangannya lembut di bahu Asteria.)

column1: (In an instant, Asteria feels a vast ocean of massive data streams surging into her Neural cloud. The power that was severely depleted from her long-distance raid and tracking is replenished to a great extent, even overflowing, in a fraction of a second.)
column2: (Seketika, Asteria merasakan samudra arus data raksasa membanjir masuk ke Neural cloud-nya. Tenaga yang terkuras habis oleh serbuan dan pelacakan jarak jauh terisi kembali dengan sangat cepat, bahkan meluap, hanya dalam sepersekian detik.)

column1: Alright, alright, relax, take a deep breath.
column2: Ya, ya, santai, tarik napas dalam-dalam.

column1: It's just shooting down a slightly larger lizard.
column2: Ini cuma menembak jatuh kadal yang sedikit lebih besar.

column1: You just need to maintain the link. Trajectory aiming and other calculations... leave them all to me.
column2: Kau cukup menjaga sambungannya. Pembidikan lintasan dan perhitungan lainnya... serahkan semuanya padaku.

column1: (The giant dragon above the horizon was still flapping its wings and roaring, arrogant and overbearing.)
column2: (Naga raksasa di atas cakrawala itu masih mengepakkan sayap dan mengaum, angkuh dan congkak.)

column1: (With the assistance of Dandelion's computing power, Asteria firmly locked onto the giant dragon's vital points. Her finger rested lightly on the trigger, and her eyes instantly became as cold as frost.)
column2: (Dengan bantuan daya komputasi Dandelion, Asteria mengunci mati titik vital naga raksasa itu. Jarinya menempel ringan di pelatuk, dan matanya seketika berubah sedingin embun beku.)

column1: Prepare to perish... creature that shouldn't exist here.
column2: Bersiaplah binasa... makhluk yang seharusnya tidak ada di sini.

column1: The "Vindicator's Mark" will not play a dirge of mourning for you—
column2: Vindicator's Mark tidak akan memainkan lagu duka untukmu—

column1: Bang.
column2: Dor.

column1: (Accompanied by Dandelion's understated playful onomatopoeia, Asteria pulled the heavy trigger without hesitation.)
column2: (Diiringi tiruan bunyi jenaka Dandelion yang datar, Asteria menarik pelatuk yang berat itu tanpa ragu.)

column1: (The next second, a snow-bright energy beam bright enough to cause temporary blindness crashed through the sky. Carrying world-destroying energy, like the mythical spear Gungnir that never misses, it pierced straight towards the giant dragon's head!)
column2: (Detik berikutnya, sinar energi seputih salju yang cukup terang untuk membutakan sementara membelah langit. Membawa energi penghancur dunia, bagai tombak mitos Gungnir yang tak pernah meleset, sinar itu menusuk lurus ke kepala naga raksasa!)

column1: (Coordinating with it were the tactical penetrations and precise point removals of various squads such as the third-generation Doll squad, Winged Hussars, and Zucchero.)
column2: (Menyelaraskan dengan itu adalah tusukan taktis dan penghabisan titik demi titik yang presisi dari berbagai regu seperti regu Doll generasi ketiga, Winged Hussars, dan Zucchero.)

column1: (The enemy's battle formation visibly fell into chaos. The remaining forces were surrounded and showed signs of routing, even starting to affect the entire line of surrounding troops.)
column2: (Formasi tempur musuh jelas jatuh ke dalam kekacauan. Sisa pasukannya terkepung dan menunjukkan tanda-tanda kocar-kacir, bahkan mulai memengaruhi seluruh barisan pasukan di sekitarnya.)

column1: (Witnessing such a victorious scene, the atmosphere in the command center immediately became excited. Vasily clenched his fists in exhilaration, and the young technicians and signalmen nearby couldn't help but let out low cheers.)
column2: (Menyaksikan pemandangan kemenangan itu, suasana di pusat komando langsung bergairah. Vasily mengepalkan tinju dengan sukacita, dan para teknisi muda serta petugas sinyal di sekitarnya tak kuasa menahan sorak kecil.)

column1: (Looking at their exhilarated appearances, I couldn't help but show a bit of a smile. If such a smooth battle situation can continue, Mokosh's wish to take back its future from the Financial Conglomerate will surely be realized soon.)
column2: (Melihat wajah-wajah mereka yang berseri, aku tak kuasa menahan senyum tipis. Kalau jalannya pertempuran semulus ini bisa berlanjut, keinginan Mokosh merebut kembali masa depannya dari Financial Conglomerate pasti akan segera terwujud.)

column1: (Countless massive sparks continued to explode in the sky and on the ground, forcefully bombarding Mokosh's close-in weapon system, and the shockwaves triggered by the explosions further caused the sky and the earth to tremble violently at the same time.)
column2: (Percikan besar tak terhitung terus meledak di langit dan di bumi, menggempur keras sistem senjata jarak dekat Mokosh, dan gelombang kejut yang dipicu ledakan itu membuat langit dan bumi berguncang hebat bersamaan.)

column1: (On the other hand, outside the Oathguard ranks, there were still many remaining personnel left on the ground to assist with resident evacuation and support logistics. If the dome was breached, falling debris from high above would very likely cause harm to them.)
column2: (Di sisi lain, di luar barisan Oathguard, masih banyak personel yang tertinggal di permukaan untuk membantu evakuasi warga dan menopang logistik. Kalau kubahnya jebol, puing yang jatuh dari ketinggian sangat mungkin melukai mereka.)
